author: SnowSX3
body:
Appealing the permanent ban for my alternate account 76282334BG 

Can I get the evidence too?

Someone asked what servers had CTF as a gamemode.
I told him that Overcast had CTF but they were closing in a month.
I then told him that Brawl.com had a good CTF plug-in.
I then got perma-banned.

At no point did I encourage him or anyone else on the server to leave Avicus to join these servers.

We were talking casually about other Minecraft servers which is allowed in the chat.
I would understand the ban if I told him to play on those servers but considering I was just answering his question as to what other servers hosted a gamemode that Avicus does not offer.

Many times I have seen others ask where they could play Skywars on Avicus, with Hypixel being a popular answer. 
Yet no action was taken then because no-one was promoting anything, they were just in discussion.
Talking about other servers is not against any rule on Avicus, and that is what I was doing.

I was not promoting other servers and had no intention to do so. I respect this server too much to blatantly advertise other servers on it.
There's no point in me advertising, considering I am planning to send in a staff application soon.

I had no intention to advertise other servers.
I apologise if miscommunication occurred as a result of this,  I would never do anything to intentionally harm this server. 

I have done too much work, I have spent too much time, and I have made too many friends on this server to pointlessly advertise on it and get myself banned.

I ask the Senior Staff to reconsider this ban.
Cheers.

I have decided to appeal your alts ban for the fact that you did not say "join" and encourage others to join the server. But for future reference, please do not post server ip's in chat, regardless of the conversation. If needed, you can PM them it.

Regards,
Fouled
